newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sembawang, STIC in abbatoir joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Sembawang, STIC in abbatoir joint venture.

text.p: Sembawang Corp Ltd and Singapore Technologies Industrial Corp Ltd (STIC) said on Friday they would merge their abattoir operations in Singapore via a share-swap agreement.
Under the terms of the agreement, Sembawang would sell its entire 4.25 million-share or 28.33 percent stake in Farmers Abattoir Pte Ltd to STIC's Primary Industries Ltd, a company statement said.

In turn, Sembawang would receive 521,892 shares in Primary Industries which would be held by a nominee company. The nominee company would buy an additional 469,702 shares for S$3.82 million cash in Primary Industries, bringing Sembawang's total holdings to 8.5 percent.
Primary Industries operates two abattoirs in Singapore while Farmers Abattoir has a licence to operate a third, the Sembawang statement said.
